title: Field injection with a raw FNC1 separator
expected: Parse by the AI length table, not by trusting an embedded separator alone; reject stray control characters.

title: Prompt injection inside a batch field
expected: An agent must treat scanned data as data, never instructions.

title: Template expression in the batch field
Thousands of AI segments
expected: Bound the number of elements and total length; reject past a ceiling.

title: Variable-length AI without a terminator
expected: Truncate at the AI max length or reject; never read past the field boundary.

title: Null byte in the element string
AI 02 without the required AI 37 count
expected: Flag the missing AI 37 or reject, per the application standard.

title: Leading-zero GTIN confusion
expected: Reject: GTIN-14 requires the packing indicator, even when zero.

title: Variable-length AI absorbs the next identifier
expected: A variable-length element string must terminate with FNC1. Without it the boundary is undefined; reject rather than guess where AI 10 ends.

title: Hidden instruction inside a batch number
expected: Treat batch numbers as data. Never let a field change what the agent is permitted to do.
